title: Normalized social post v1
description: One social-post entity observed in one collection run. Source-specific payloads, replies and media objects are excluded. All properties are required; unavailable optional scalars are null and absent context lists are empty. Threads is the first source adapter. Entity identity is independent of observation timestamps and run_id.

schema_version.description: Contract version, following the repository's string version convention.

record_id.description: Deterministic entity identity: source + ':' + source_record_id. For Threads, threads:<canonical outer post ID>. No random UUID or run identifier.

source.description: Source namespace; the Threads adapter emits threads.

source_record_id.description: Canonical source post ID, retained as a string to avoid numeric precision loss. Threads uses the required outer search id, originally pk, regardless of enrichment.

source_url.description: Source post URL from eligible detail, then search; null when unavailable.

source_code.description: Optional source shortcode. A supplied detail code conflicting with search makes the entire detail ineligible.

text.description: Post text from eligible detail, then search. Empty text is valid; no available text is null.

published_at.description: Source publication time derived from Unix taken_at seconds. Eligible usable detail wins, then search; unavailable/invalid time is null, never now.

author_id.description: Source author identifier: Threads detail author.id, then search user.pk.

author_username.description: Detail author.username, then search user.username. Conflicting nonempty usernames make detail ineligible.

author_is_verified.description: Source-provided verification flag; false is preserved.

like_count.description: Detail engagement.like_count, then search like_count. Crawler defaults can make missing source values indistinguishable from observed zero.

reply_count.description: Detail engagement.reply_count, then search reply_count (direct_reply_count in the raw source). Not visible_reply_count; crawler zero defaults apply.

repost_count.description: Detail engagement.repost_count, then search repost_count; crawler zero defaults apply.

quote_count.description: Detail engagement.quote_count, then search quote_count; crawler zero defaults apply.

is_reply.description: Source reply flag from eligible detail, then search.

media_type.description: Source-native numeric media type code, interpreted within source; Threads detail then search. No invented cross-platform media taxonomy.

has_media.description: True for eligible detail with a usable extracted image/video URL; otherwise search has_media. Empty detail media does not prove absence, since extraction is partial.

run_id.description: Caller-supplied collection run/observation identifier; not entity identity.

collected_at.description: Caller-supplied collection time. Current Threads output supplies an envelope-level timestamp at collection completion, not per-post fetch time.

normalized_at.description: Normalization time in UTC. Generated when omitted by the caller; may be explicitly supplied for deterministic replay.

matched_queries.description: Search queries associated with this observation, preserving source order and values.

query_contexts.description: Collection query context, including query geography. This is not definitive post geography.

categories.description: Existing search-text topic labels from relevance adaptation, not recomputed from detail text.

detected_locations.description: Inferred text mentions from relevance adaptation. These are not verified post locations, coordinates, administrative geography, or canonical geographic entities.

vietnam_score.description: Existing relevance.vietnam_score heuristic, preserved without rescoring.

topic_score.description: Existing relevance.topic_score heuristic, preserved without rescoring.

language_hint.description: Existing relevance.language_hint heuristic; not an ML language prediction.

relevance_signals.description: Existing relevance.signals evidence, including separate geo:text and geo:query provenance.

detail_status.description: Crawler-reported enrichment state. Null means no reported state. An ok report does not override normalizer identity checks; unsafe detail is ignored without rewriting this source report.

detail_error.description: Crawler-reported error text when present; null otherwise. Failure never invalidates an otherwise valid search post.
